processing.error.tooFewFrames.whatToDo: Record a longer, steady video in good light. Keep the asset in view and avoid glare and sudden movements.
Too few frames could be matched to place the cameras and build a reliable 3D map.
Film the asset again from several angles. Move slowly and keep the same surfaces visible between adjacent views.

Check the frame quality and overlap. Retry reconstruction; if it fails again, record a steadier video from more angles.
